end.parentNote: Anika practised ways to keep school clean and safe, including using bins, preventing litter, and explaining why plastic and foil should not enter the garden. They also discussed that keeping the school clean is everyone’s shared job. Wet-versus-dry waste sorting and how a compost pit works need more practice; the bin choice for cups was not secured during the lesson. At home, practise sorting a few household items into wet/green-bin and dry/blue-bin groups, and explain why each belongs there.
